ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What would happen to cottontails if all the grass died?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a food web. At the lower left there is grass labeled "Grass"; beside the grass there is an arrow pointing to the cottontail rabbit labeled "Cottontail" in the middle-lower left, indicating that grass is a food source for the cottontail rabbit. Reasoning: The question asks what would happen to the cottontail rabbit if all the grass died. According to food web rules, if an animal's food source disappears, it will lose its energy source. Because the cottontail rabbit eats grass, after all the grass dies, the cottontail rabbit will lack food and starve.
